```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.align='center',out.width='50%'}
library(sf)
library(plotly)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(ggplot2)

# Load the map of Africa
africa <- ne_countries(continent = "Africa", returnclass = "sf")

# List of countries to highlight
highlight_countries <- c("Angola", "Benin", "Burkina Faso", 
                         "Cameroon", "Nigeria", "Mozambique", "Tanzania", "Senegal" ,"Sierra Leone" ,"Ghana" , "Benin" , "Ghana", "Dem. Rep. Congo" , "Uganda" )

# Add a new column for highlighting
africa$highlight <- ifelse(africa$name %in% highlight_countries, "Highlighted", "Not Highlighted")

# Create the map
p <- ggplot(data = africa) +
     geom_sf(aes(fill = highlight, text = name), color = "darkgrey") +
     scale_fill_manual(values = c("Highlighted" = "#fdcdac", "Not Highlighted" = "lightgray")) +
     theme_void() +  # Removes axes and background
     theme(panel.grid = element_blank())+
     theme(legend.position = "none")# Removes grid lines
p

```
